instructions.question: Does this comment express warm support, clear hostility or distress about the institute, government, public or situation, or neither?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default: calm or reasoned questions, corrections, arguments and policy demands (even indignant ones), statistics, notes that cases rose or fell, dry irony, jokes, teasing of tagged friends, town-ranking banter and mild regret. Negative needs a strong marker: figures called faked, copied, hidden or suspicious, sarcastic 'under control', partisan jabs, insults or swearing, strong exasperation or alarm, or denial slogans. Positive needs warmth: thanks, praise, blessings, encouragement, or caring advice to stay safe.

neutral.what: Calm or reasoned questions, corrections, arguments, policy demands, statistics, anecdotes, irony, teasing friends, banter, mild regret.
examples: Sa keq, numri kaq i larte [What a pity, such a high number]
Paska ra pak pi dje [It has dropped a bit since yesterday]
Etrit Sinani ti po mshefesh spo kallxon qe e ki [Etrit, you're hiding it, not telling that you have it]
neutral.cues: a/pse (questions), duhet (should), ju lutem (please), qitni listen (publish the list), lshoi bajrakun (dropped the flag), prin (leads), ma gjall (livelier), hahaha, tagged names
neutral.not_for: Explicit fake-number claims, partisan jabs, swearing or strong outbursts (negative).

positive.what: Thanks, praise, congratulations, sincere prayers, encouragement, caring calls to protect each other.
examples: Urime të Sheruarve! [Congratulations to the recovered!]
Kujdes vllazni se dona ta mbyllim vetëveten nëse vazhdon kshtu mbane distancën mos dilni pa nevoj [Careful brothers, or we'll lock ourselves in again, keep distance, don't go out without need]
Rip covid 19. [RIP covid 19.]
positive.cues: urime (congratulations), ju lumt (well done), hallall (well deserved), perhajr (all the best), zoti e sheroft (God heal), respekt (respect), herojt (heroes)
positive.not_for: Notes that cases fell, jokey 'ishalla' or 'ma gjall' cheering, greetings to tagged friends (neutral).

negative.what: Claims of faked or suspicious figures, sarcasm at officials, partisan jabs, insults, swearing, strong anger, alarm or despair, denial.
examples: Dje 226 sod 224 mos jeni tja bo copy paste. [Yesterday 226, today 224, are you copy-pasting?]
A boni teste pa libreze partie? [Do you test without a party card?]
Tmerr valla,po lëvizin pa masa mbrojtëse dhe në grupe! [Horror, they move around unprotected and in groups!]
Maska = skllavëri [Mask = slavery]
negative.cues: copy paste, dyshimt (suspicious), rrena (lies), mashtrim (deceit), prapaskena (behind the scenes), nën kontroll (sarcastic), tmerr (horror), marre (shame), bollni ma (enough already), doreheqje (resignation)
negative.not_for: Calm doubts, corrections, policy demands and playful jokes (neutral).
